unit_decision: The main target changes the previous2n+1 hypothesis to genuine2n doubling at large radii in arbitrary locally compact groups. Its new full left-Haar energy and local approximate-coset short-representative construction are retained. The graph1.3 and finite1.4 variants and all2.x/3.x supporting results get no extra unit count. Unselected finite-presentation/higher-growth consequences are not included as selected outcomes.
difficulty_reason: The proof adapts multiplicative-energy covering arguments to general left Haar measures without assuming bi-invariance. It coarsens overlapping approximate-group translates into strongly separated pieces and constructs short representatives by a stabilized ball exploration. These local coset-like bounds control later powers and produce the explicit tripling and approximate-group constants.
